style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
motion_rule: the camera never stops, riding sideways alongside him, the marble hall tearing past, and whips round at 2.20, 5.05 and 7.35; new shot size every beat, one action per beat, no push in; he throws his whole body a full length in every beat and fills half the frame height, never a wide shot; ONE pigeon crosses the lens in every beat, a wing from the glass
character: ONE spotted male hyena, untucked shirt, loosened tie, bared teeth, ruffled fur, jaw chewing nonstop; the same animal every beat
second_characters: ONE pigeon teller in a green visor, always in flight
props: ONE long-handled net; fat banknote bundles the pigeon hands him; loose notes drifting through the hall, pattern only
prop_continuity: only ONE net, in his paws until 6.00, then out of frame for good; bundles are always held or handed
environment: marble bank hall at noon, tall counters, glass doors, notes flying everywhere, warm white daylight, hard rim light from both sides

audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, level, 3.2 syllables per second
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, no silent opening, each line fits its own beat; after 7.35 only hall noise and rustling paper
audio.lip_sync: muzzle to the lens, jaw opens on every syllable, mouth empty until 6.65, not voice-over
audio.sfx: net whoosh, paper rustle, jaw clack, wing beats

timeline.a: bursts out, one body-long swing of the net at a flying note, jaw clacking, chewing; the pigeon dives at him
on the run punches the net a body length forward, cheeks pumping; the pigeon rams a fat bundle into his chewing jaws
a whole-body turn swings the net to his chest, shredded paper pouring from the mesh; the pigeon pecks a scrap in flight
hurls the net sideways across the frame and snatches it back mid-leap; the pigeon darts under the toss
slams shoulder-first into the glass doors, net dragging behind; the pigeon overtakes him, bounces off the glass
still skidding forward, he snaps round over his shoulder and swings the net into empty air behind; the pigeon jerks out from under it
flings the net back at arm's length, out of frame; the pigeon hooks it with a wing and hauls it off
muzzle up, skidding on, he slams both paws over his pockets, tie flying, a note stuck on his fang; the pigeon pokes at it
mid-turn he whips his whole body round and gulps the note down, throat pumping; the pigeon recoils backwards
he lunges at the lens, braking on the marble, muzzle huge; the pigeon flies in and lands on his shoulder
stepping into the lens he sweeps ONE paw past his open muzzle, tongue out long, licking scraps off it; the pigeon flaps off past the lens
bares his teeth at the lens, jaw clacking as in beat one, his paw shoots out sideways for a new fat bundle; the pigeon nudges it to him
